confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Santiago price levels; no live venue or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain, since July is winter and usually a lower-demand period for city hotels. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (pisco sour and a glass of wine versus draught beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from web search results that cite the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Latin American basis: Santiago sits among the higher-priced South American capitals for dining and mid-range hotels. No web search was used for city prices; this positioning rests on general knowledge.
